metadata.description: AI floor-plan tools for Claude: brief → 2D plan → 3D model, DXF and IFC.

plugins.name: ar-plan-generator
plugins.description: Generates 2D architectural floor plans from a written brief or sketch, changes existing plans, and checks them for MEP readiness. Outputs SVG, layered DXF, IFC4 for Revit/Navisworks, a 3D model page, a build replay page, a 2D-to-3D build video, AR Plan Studio JSON and a check report.
